title: First Aid Guidelines
content: To stop bleeding, apply firm, direct pressure to the wound with a clean cloth or sterile dressing. If the blood soaks through, do not remove the cloth; instead, add another on top. Elevate the injured area if possible. For minor burns, run cool (not cold) water over the burn for at least 10 minutes. Do not pop blisters. Do not apply ice, butter, or ointments immediately as this can trap heat. If a person is choking, perform the Heimlich maneuver by standing behind them and applying quick, upward abdominal thrusts just above the navel. In case of unconsciousness and no breathing, begin CPR immediately with chest compressions.
